sample_unit: adult encounters reviewed in silent testing
models_evaluated: convolutional neural network opioid misuse screener (NLP with UMLS concept mapping)

links.outcome: Silent-mode performance of deep learning screener on live EHR notes versus physician review
links.effect: Silent testing on 100 adult encounters showed sensitivity 93% (95% CI 66%-99%) and specificity 92% (95% CI 84%-96%), similar to published validation studies.
links.quote: On-site silent testing of the deep learning algorithm demonstrated a sensitivity of 93% (95% CI 66%-99%) and specificity of 92% (95% CI 84%-96%), similar to published validation studies.

links.outcome: Whether end-user interviews changed BPA design and materials before rollout
links.effect: Five end-user interviews informed an educational flyer and modified the BPA to exclude certain patients and allow refusal of recommendations.
links.quote: Five interviews were conducted; they informed the development of an educational flyer and further modified the BPA to exclude certain patients and allow refusal of recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Cloud-based real-time NLP pipeline design with shared pseudocode for ingesting HL7 notes
Cybersecurity approval process for PHI exchange between cloud vendors

screen.reason: The study describes and evaluates an operational real-time NLP pipeline implementation in a live hospital EHR system, including silent testing (shadow mode validation) and user-centered design adjustments to clinical alerts before full go-live.

primary.practice: silent testing and user-centered alert design prior to live deployment
